summary: Control and hybrid nodes serve the UI and API through uwsgi (WSGI), Daphne (ASGI) and NGINX on 443. Scale with multiple control nodes behind a load balancer and max 100 connections per node; clients should use dynamic inventory, webhooks instead of polling, bulk APIs and token authentication.
questions: How do I scale the controller web service?
Why is the controller API slow under heavy automation?
Should API clients use token or basic auth?
What web servers does automation controller use?
